57119.subject: Civic Education
57119.question_text: Which of the following nationalists is associated with democratic socialism?
57119.explanation: Obafemi Awolowo was a Nigerian nationalist and statesman who is closely associated with the ideology of democratic socialism. Democratic socialism is a political ideology that supports establishing a democratically run and decentralized form of socialist economy. He advocated for social justice and the implementation of welfare policies. Awolowo's political and economic views emphasised the role of the state in providing essential services and promoting economic development to benefit all citizens.

57247.question_text: Which of the following skills is not needed for youth empowerment?
57247.explanation:
Youth empowerment focuses on providing young people with the skills, values and opportunities to become confident, responsible and productive members of society. These include:

  • Non-cognitive skills (e.g. emotional intelligence, resilience)

  • Manipulative skills (practical or hands-on skills like craftsmanship)

  • Transversal skills (also called transferable or soft skills—e.g. communication, teamwork, adaptability)

57258.subject: Civic Education
57258.explanation: Constitutional democracy is also known as limited government. A constitutional democracy operates under a system where the powers of the government are limited by a constitution. This ensures that the government is not above the law and that individual rights and freedoms are protected. The Constitution provides a framework that delineates the structure and function of government, establishing checks and balances to prevent the abuse of power.

57288.subject: Civic Education
57288.question_text: Democracy could be described as a form of government in which people
57288.explanation: Democracy is a form of government in which people participate in the decision-making process. In a democratic system, citizens have the right and opportunity to participate in the decision-making process, typically through voting, engaging in public debate and holding their elected representatives accountable. This participation ensures that the government reflects the will of the people.  While the other options are related to aspects that can be encouraged or facilitated by a democratic system, they do not define democracy itself.

options.text: produce sound political manifesto for national development.
participate in the decision making process

57294.subject: Civic Education
57294.question_text: Which of the following is the consequence of political apathy?
57294.explanation: Political apathy, where citizens are disengaged and do not participate in the political process, can lead to the emergence of incompetent leaders. When people do not vote or engage in political activities, it reduces the chances of electing qualified and capable leaders, as the decision-making is left to a smaller, possibly less informed or motivated group. This can result in leaders being chosen who do not represent the best interests of the public.
